main_text.p: Clemens octauus,patria Florentinus, Leonis de cimi Papæ nothus(dixiffem nepos) & Iulius antea uocatus,tituli S. page.notes: Underlined words: "Leonis de cimi Papæ nothus", "scelerato patri ... filius" and "roma ui capta" are underlined in the print; the underlines are not transcribed as markup. The two marks "7" in the left margin beside "feculorum" and "magis" are doubtful; they may be printed marks or reference signs and are transcribed as notes with [?] omitted. "fcuere", "dã", "patri[?]" and "quae" are doubtful readings; the long s is copied as "s" where it appears as f-like type. The verse is set in one stanza as printed in two indented lines and continuation lines, joined in running text.
